notes.title: The Wizards Who Fell In A Hole - Version 2.1.3 Released
notes.notes:
A minor update with a few fixes:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved support for gamepads.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed angle of some of the monsters when they are falling before they turn into food.
[*] Restored the falling stars on the end sequence because they had mysteriously disappeared (some incompetent wizarding magic was no doubt to blame).
[/list]

notes.title: The Wizards Who Fell In A Hole - Version 2.1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
It's update time! We've fixed a few things and put in a few new features, many of which bring the game closer to the original Xbox 360 release many years ago.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The in-game status bar now shows which special items are active (e.g. rapid fire) and in the case of timed items, for how long.
[*] Added encouragement text after completing a level ("Extraordinary", "Top Drawer", etc).
[*] Special items now award points!
[*] The number of credits has been increased from 10 to 15.
[*] Added the meaning of life, the universe and everything (see if you can find it!).
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the characters could jump twice as high if the jump button was pressed for a second time when they were in the air near a platform.
[*] Special items are regenerated when going back a level or restarting the current level.
[*] Fixed bug with number of points displayed when an item is collected fading out too quickly.
[/list]
Thank you to everyone for your continued love and support for this game. And a super special thanks to Audiolady for suggesting most of the above, and for making me laugh many times during on most wonderfully random forum thread I have ever had the pleasure to be a part of ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 2.1.1 Released
notes.notes:
We've released a small update to the game with some minor fixes and an overhaul of the user interface so text, menus, buttons and so on look better.

We've also added a high scores leaderboard which displays the highest score you've managed in a single credit. We've added our score already - who can be the first one to beat it?!

notes.title: Minor update...
notes.notes:
Version 2.0.1 - improved menu navigation slightly so the "back" button always goes back to the previous menu.

Also if you are the one person who experienced a crash when plugging a new joystick/gamepad in, rest assured this has also now been resolved!
